scripts.build: npm run typecheck && if [ -z "$SKIP_NATIVE_BUILDS_IF_PRESENT" ] || [ ! -f dist/src/libskipruntime.wasm ]; then skargo build -r --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib --manifest-path=../skiplang/ffi/Skargo.toml --out-dir=./dist/src/; else echo "dist/src/libskipruntime.wasm present; skipping skargo build (SKIP_NATIVE_BUILDS_IF_PRESENT)"; fi
